title: Hosted Entra entry terminates in the existing Vistara cookie session
statement: Planned hosted Microsoft Entra ID entry runs server-side OpenID Connect authorization code flow with PKCE and terminates in the existing Vistara cookie session; allowlisted Entra object and tenant identifiers guard an atomic first-owner bootstrap, the local password recovery owner remains available, and the Azure bootstrap stays optional while Compose remains supported.
rationale: The approved plan keeps hosted sign-in an additional entry point rather than a second session model, so browser tokens, owner provisioning, and deployment optionality stay reviewable before any CLOUD task is implemented.
